purpose: Test existing recovery-trained and clean-trained checkpoints from identical actual histories; no new training

eligibility.source: all completed fixed-I pool rollouts; same make_pair failure and common-prefix rules as training
eligibility.initial_and_target_budget: Both condition prefixes and replayed reference suffix must fit context 8192, new-generation 2048, per-turn 192, and matched remaining calls
eligibility.report: All pool IDs retained in selection ledger; count every exclusion reason; never select using A/C outcomes
eligibility.selection_bias: Conditional on failed I rollout and reference-replay constructibility; not all-error recovery
eligibility.partial_collection: Do not start A/C or score incomplete fixed collection; retain failures and request infrastructure decision, not automatic resampling

resume.order: Fixed pool order, clean then divergent per accepted question; same order in all arms
resume.generated_token_scope: fresh continuation budget; fixed history is not charged as new generation
resume.context_scope: full actual history; longer divergent history has less context space, separately reported
resume.required_state_restore: Re-execute actual messages/events, verify full typed handle-state digest before inference; no text-only restoration

statistics.primary: Mean across questions of mean two-seed C-minus-A correctness in divergent condition
secondary: within-question difference of divergent and clean C-minus-A contrasts
full-prefill input and new generated tokens

bootstrap.unit: question; keep both seeds and both conditions together
bootstrap.scope: conditional on four fixed checkpoints and selected constructible states

statistics.failed_continuations: All frozen accepted states remain in each arm denominator; no result-driven reruns or deletions
statistics.sample_size: All eligible states in fixed 2400 pool; report intervals and limited power, do not enlarge after seeing results

runtime_gate.python: Linux Python 3.10; actual pinned project environment
runtime_gate.gpu: Use only explicitly idle compute GPUs; unresolved occupancy blocks start; no reset/kill/admin training
mandatory: exact tokenizer IDs and target budget preflight
old-dev GPU resume smoke at most 300 GPU-seconds
execution binding frozen before new-pool inference

interpretation.stronger_diagnostic_support: C improvement at same divergent state and positive divergence-minus-clean interaction support adaptation to this history distribution, not proven semantic error detection
interpretation.general_gain: Similar improvement in both conditions supports general execution improvement
interpretation.null: Report null/uncertain results without launching several alternatives
interpretation.training_after_this_round: At most one targeted control only after literature, state results, real human review and method revision are assessed; no automatic training
